title: KLAC is Overvalued at 9.37X P/S: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
author: Na
description: KLA (KLAC) shares have gained 28% over the past year and are rated a Zacks Rank #2 Buy despite trading at a premium 9.37X forward price-to-sales ratio. The semiconductor process control leader is benefiting from accelerating AI infrastructure investments, strong demand for advanced packaging solutions, and robust earnings growth. However, supply chain constraints and elevated memory costs pose near-term challenges. Analysts believe the premium valuation is justified by solid growth prospects, making it attractive for long-term investors.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong position in semiconductor process control with 29% YoY revenue growth in Q1 FY2027, accelerating AI infrastructure investments, growing advanced packaging demand, expanding services business, and improving earnings estimates (up 5.3% over 30 days). Rated Zacks Rank #2 Buy. Offset partially by premium valuation (9.37X forward P/S), supply chain constraints, and elevated memory costs impacting margins.

title: Can Applied Materials Capitalize on Rising HBM Demand in 2026?
author: Na
description: Applied Materials (AMAT) is capitalizing on surging AI infrastructure demand, with DRAM revenues jumping 52% year-over-year to record levels in fiscal Q3 2026. The company raised its advanced packaging revenue growth outlook to over 70% from 50%, driven by high-bandwidth memory (HBM) demand. However, AMAT stock trades at a premium valuation (P/S of 6.38X vs. industry 3.01X) and carries a Hold rating, with growth dependent on sustained customer capital spending in the cyclical memory industry.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong revenue growth (52% DRAM YoY), record DRAM levels, raised guidance for advanced packaging (70% growth), and expanded product portfolio position the company well for AI-driven semiconductor demand.

title: Zacks.com featured highlights include Ralph Lauren, Expedia, NVIDIA and Lam Research
author: Zacks.Com
description: Zacks.com highlights four GARP (Growth at a Reasonable Price) stocks as attractive investment opportunities: Ralph Lauren, Expedia Group, NVIDIA, and Lam Research. These stocks combine value and growth metrics, offering solid earnings prospects with reasonable valuations. All four companies have raised guidance, demonstrated strong earnings surprises, and maintain positive momentum in their respective sectors.

title: 3 Reasons Growth Investors Will Love Lam Research (LRCX)
author: Na
description: Lam Research (LRCX) is identified as a compelling growth stock opportunity, featuring a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating and Growth Score of B. The semiconductor equipment maker demonstrates exceptional earnings growth of 65.2% (vs. 48.8% industry average), strong cash flow growth of 36% year-over-year, and positive earnings estimate revisions, making it a solid choice for growth-oriented investors.
